name: Vosem' Dnej
source:
What is... Eight Days?

This is a very short story about friendship and first love. About the justice of death and the injustice of life. A story... No, rather a short tale... A tale about a sixteen-year-old boy who dreams of... Of life? Yes. He dreams of friendship. Of love. And of simple, boyish, street romance — the romance of youth.
translation:
什么是……八天？

这是一个关于友情和初恋的非常短的故事。关于死亡的正义和生命的不正义。一个故事……不，而是一个短篇故事……一个关于一个十六岁男孩梦想……生活的故事？是的。他梦想着友谊。出于爱。还有简单、孩子气的街头浪漫——青春的浪漫。
